title.original: AugServe: Adaptive Request Scheduling for Augmented Large Language Model Inference Serving
title.zh: AugServe：增强型大型语言模型推理服务的自适应请求调度
title.en: AugServe: Adaptive Request Scheduling for Augmented Large Language Model Inference Serving

inclusion_reason.zh: AugServe 的两阶段请求排序和动态 token 批次控制器可作为增强型 LLM 服务的通用 SLO 调度层。
inclusion_reason.en: AugServe's two-stage request ordering and dynamic token-budget controller form a reusable SLO scheduling layer for augmented LLM services.

abstract.zh: AugServe 面向带外部工具的增强型 LLM 请求，以有效吞吐——在时延 SLO 内完成的请求数——为优化目标。它用两阶段自适应调度重排请求，并依据实时硬件状态与负载调整批次 token 上限。
abstract.en: AugServe optimizes effective throughput for tool-augmented LLM requests—the number completed within latency SLOs. A two-stage scheduler reorders requests and adapts the batch token budget to live load and hardware conditions.

problem.zh: FCFS 会让长或工具增强请求阻塞队首，固定批次 token 限额也无法适应负载和设备状态，导致大量请求排队超出 SLO。
problem.en: FCFS lets long or augmented requests block the head of the queue, while a static token budget cannot react to load or device state, pushing many requests beyond their SLOs.

approach.zh: 第一阶段利用增强请求的推理特征确定初始顺序，第二阶段用运行时反馈持续修正决策；另一个控制环动态改变每批 token 容量。
approach.en: A first stage orders requests using augmented-inference features, a second refines those choices from runtime feedback, and a separate control loop adjusts token capacity per batch.

system_design.zh: AugServe 在请求队列前加入特征感知排序器和运行时重评分器，并把硬件利用率、实时到达率等信号反馈给批处理控制器，协同降低等待时间。
system_design.en: AugServe places a feature-aware ordering stage and runtime re-ranker ahead of the queue, feeding hardware and arrival-rate signals into a batching controller so queueing and execution adapt together.

key_results.zh: 实验表明 AugServe 相比 vLLM 和 InferCept 可提高 SLO 内有效吞吐，并显著缩短首 token 时间。
key_results.en: Experiments report higher SLO-compliant effective throughput and substantially shorter time to first token than vLLM and InferCept.

limitations.zh: 摘要未描述工具调用时延分布变化、特征预测误差或不同优先级请求的公平性；两阶段策略对新型增强工作流的迁移性仍需验证。
limitations.en: The abstract does not characterize shifting tool latency, feature-prediction error, or fairness across request classes; transfer to unseen augmented workflows remains unproven.

workloads: augmented LLM inference requests under fluctuating load

notes.zh: 增强请求、vLLM/InferCept 及摘要明示的吞吐和 TTFT 上限已录入；模型、硬件、工具类型与负载曲线待全文审计。
notes.en: Augmented requests, vLLM/InferCept, and abstract-stated throughput and TTFT bounds are recorded; models, hardware, tool types, and load curves await full-text audit.
